text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"multiple connected paragraphs","quality":"organizational development","description":"It presents several separate ideas in a more extended, structured way rather than a single brief paragraph."},{"evidence":"“First thing I will like to accomplish…”, “Last thing I have to say…”","quality":"discourse structure","description":"It uses clear transitions and sequencing to organize points across the essay."},{"evidence":"“I will try to take more years of school…”, “I have also wanted to rap…”","quality":"idea elaboration","description":"It develops claims with more supporting details and examples instead of only listing reasons."},{"evidence":"“I have stared to play basketball more…”, “Now I take lessons for it”","quality":"sentence elaboration","description":"It builds more sentences with added explanation, showing greater control of extended expression."},{"evidence":"“My dad always said…”, “Fact checkers say…”","quality":"variety of evidence sources","description":"It brings in quoted sayings and outside references to support ideas, giving the writing more range."},{"evidence":"“I will like”, “im”, “dont”, “stared”","quality":"overall writing control","description":"Despite errors, it shows a broader command of English than the other essay through more sustained attempts at complex communication."}]}
